reading.title: Why do we give up?
reading.text: Most people who start learning a language give up within six months. Psychologists say the biggest obstacle is not talent but habit. Learners who make consistent progress usually study a little every day rather than for hours at the weekend. They also learn to resist the temptation to switch apps or courses whenever they feel bored. Teachers can assist by setting small, clear goals. Persistent learners, the research shows, are not those who never fail, but those who keep going after a bad week.
